title: A local image build takes the name CI publishes
foundBy: session agent, reviewing how local builds reach images (tasks/pin-on-local-builds.md, section 7)
details: `cs-sandbox build` of a version no registry holds tags the image `ghcr.io/<owner>/sandbox:<version>`. That is the name CI pushes for the same version, so bytes built on this machine pass for CI's. Images are not reproducible, so the two differ. `create` only ever asks for that name, so a host keeps its local image even once CI publishes the real one. The slim image is named the same way.
